rows.textLatex: Describe the basic structure and working principle of a programmable logic device with the help of necessary circuit diagram.
Why are diodes or transistors not used for MOS devices? Describe any one switching technology adopted in FPGA to implement configurable hardware.
With the help of a block diagram discuss the functions of different components of a PAL device.
State the reasons for different speed performance of ICs.
Draw and describe the structure of a macrocell used in Altera MAX 7000.
Explain the process used in CAD system for configuring SPLD.
With a simple example describe the transistor pair logic used is FPGA.
What is difference between 'bit' and 'std_logic'? How many different states are available as per IEEE standards in VHDL? Write down their names and symbols. Write their priority list.
Write a VHDL program to develop one Tri-stated gate with proper circuit diagram and truth table. Also write a proper test bench program for the decoder.

headerLines: B. E. ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING 3RD YEAR 1ST SEMESTER EXAMINATION, 2023
parts.scriptNote: Use a separate Answer-Script for each part
parts.instructions: Answer question no.6 and any three from rest.

rows.textLatex:
Compare (any Three):
(a) Harvard architecture and Von Neumann architecture.
(b) Microprocessor and microcontroller.
(c) Subroutine and ISR
(d) Timer and counter
(e) Internal RAM and Special Function Register
What are the different types of memories available in a microcontroller?

Mention the names of Special Function Registers in context with Timer operation. Draw schematically and write the bit formats of these registers for configuring a timer. State the functions of each of the bits.

Write a program to have a blinking display of LED using the in-built timer of microcontroller. The LED blinks with a frequency of $200\text{ Hz}$. Mention all the required assumptions and requirements in your solution.

Write a program to generate blinking display of two LEDs. One LED toggling with a frequency of $400\text{ Hz}$ is controlled by the main program. A second LED blinking with a frequency of $100\text{ Hz}$ is controlled by a timer in interrupt driven mode. Mention all the required assumptions and requirements in your solution.
Write a program to count the number of pulses occurring at a pin of microcontroller. Use in-built counter of the microcontroller. Mention the resources used in your application.
Mention the names of registers involved in configuring ADC of the microcontroller. How do you select a particular input channel and alter sampling frequency of ADC.
Write a program to grab samples continuously from an analog channel of ADC. Send the result continuously to an 8-bit digital port.

Two switches are connected to two pins of one port of a microcontroller. If the switches generate bit patterns as mentioned in the following table, another pin of the microcontroller will deliver output as a result of the action taken by the microcontroller:
Switching bits (input)Output as a result of the action
00AND
01OR
10XOR
11NAND
Write an appropriate program. Explain your solution.
An 8-bit data is available at a port of microcontroller. Write a program to determine its parity. For even parity detected, one LED should glow.

Write short notes on any One:
(a) PORT programming
(b) RISC and CISC processor.
